signature.one_line: Static talking head; difference-blend white captions with one accent word; image cards above the head.
unique_devices: Captions in mix-blend-mode: difference, so white text inverts to cyan-blue where hands cross it
Rounded PIP image card parked in the top 5-35 % above the head instead of a cutaway; face never leaves frame
Big accent caps topic word drops in from above (~1.5x, blurred) at ~22 % height exactly on its spoken word
Numbered series hook title ('label #N') at centre-low, number popping in ~14 frames after the label
signature.why_it_works: The face stays on screen for trust while overlays supply variety; one coloured pain-word per line makes the message readable on mute.

hook.type: Open loop (numbered series title + one-word topic)
hook.first_frame: static medium close-up of the speaker in a work setting, a white series label word sliding up over the chest at ~79 % height

structure.what: series label + number build at centre-low, accent caps topic word drops in at the top; short dip to black
the problem stated in two lines; PIP image card above the head, one zoom-blur punch-in
full-screen flat illustration of the pain scenario, captions continue at the bottom
longest single hold: the offer as a repeated-lead list, two-line lockup + caps topic word per item
outcome promise with a second PIP image card above the head
5-frame light-leak flash, follow line to camera, white end card with logo, social icons and website

captions.what: one-line 2-4 word phrase captions, white extra-bold neo-grotesque, difference blend, 0-1 accent key word
captions.how: centred, ink centre y 80 % H, max ~72 % W, 68 px @1080x1920; slide up from +4 % H with blur + scale 1.1->1.0, sharp in 6 f, settled in 10 f, ease-out; hard-cut exit 0-1 f before the next

captions.what: list lockup: big lead words over a smaller shared noun
captions.how: lead words 114 px at centre y 74.8 %, noun ~62 px at 79.4 %, tight leading, held ~88 frames while list items change at the top

background_text.how: label 103 px white at centre y 78.9 %, slides up 2 % H with blur in 2 f on the first word; number ~1.6x on the line below (84.4 %), hard pop-in ~14 f later

background_text.when: hook (~5 %) and once per list item
background_text.how: UPPERCASE 118-130 px accent, centred at 22-23 % H above the head; drops in from ~1.5x scale, blurred, partly off the top edge, settles in ~6 f on its spoken word

motion_graphics.what: full-screen flat illustration with 1-2 animated props
motion_graphics.how: white flat-vector scene, small looping prop moves (magnifier sweep), dark bottom gradient so captions stay readable

broll_inserts.what: rounded PIP image card above the head
broll_inserts.how: x 3-97 %, y 5-35 %, corner radius ~3 % W, scale-in with blur over ~8 f, held 75-150 frames; speaker stays visible below

layout.what: single-camera MCU with the head in the middle third
layout.how: top 5-35 % kept free for PIP cards / topic words, captions on the chest at ~80 %

camera.how: scale to ~115 % with radial zoom blur over ~12 f, hold, zoom-blur back out

transitions.how: ~5 f to black then ~10 f dark tinted frame before the first caption shot (consider skipping: it stalls the hook)
5-frame white/pink light-leak flash on a hard cut

end_card.what: white end card with logo, follow prompt, social icon row and website line
end_card.how: flat #FDFDFD, black geometric sans stack centred (headline 25.9 %, logo 44-62 %, follow prompt 72.8 %, icons ~78 %, URL line ~82.5 %); 8-f dip to black before, 10-f fade out

case.caption: sentence case as spoken (capital only at sentence start / proper nouns; one line-final noun capitalised once)

captions_spec.punctuation: kept: commas and full stops at phrase ends

grouping.key_words_per_caption: 0-1 (the pain or outcome noun / adjective of the phrase)
grouping.sync: per phrase; the whole phrase appears at once
grouping.break: new caption at each phrase; previous caption hard-cuts out 0-1 frame before

layout.list_stack: during a spoken repeated-lead list ('LEAD X, LEAD Y, LEAD Z'): two centred lines, big lead words (centre y 74.8 %) over a smaller shared noun (centre y 79.4 %), held ~88 frames, with each list item dropping in as an accent caps topic word at the top
layout.on_fullscreen_graphic: same position (~80 %) over a dark bottom gradient on the white illustration
layout.safe_zone_note: sits on the chest below the lav mic; hands often cross it

caption.font_class: neo-grotesque sans, extra-bold (two-storey a, single-storey g, slanted t terminal)

closest_match.alt: Poppins 700 fits the measured proportions equally (h/w px 63/63)

caption.blend: difference blend: over dark clothing it reads white; where a hand or skin passes under it the letters invert to cyan-blue (#3C8CB4-ish) with the texture showing through. Not a separate colour tier.

key.selection_rule: one word per caption, the pain/outcome word (or a 2-word outcome phrase); many captions have none

hook_title.layout: series label word centred, centre y 78.9 %; the number ('#N') on a second line directly under it, centre y 84.4 %, '#' ink 6.17 % H (caps/figures, ~162 px), number block ~20 % W (estimated); lines overlap slightly (tight leading ~0.85)

topic_word.size_note: size varies per word (118-130 px in the reference): not fit-to-width; set per word so long words stay inside ~72 % W
topic_word.layout: centred, centre y 22.2-22.9 %, above the head

list_stack.layout: two centred lines, lead words centre y 74.8 %, shared noun centre y 79.4 %, tight leading

animation.caption_entry: slide up + blur + slight scale-down, ease-out: measured centre y 84.8 -> 82.3 -> 81.4 -> 81.0 -> 80.8 % at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10 frames and width 69.4 -> 62.4 % W (blur + ~1.1 -> 1.0 scale); sharp after ~6 frames, settled by ~10. Some captions instead blur in on the spot over 3 frames.
animation.caption_timing: per phrase; mixed: some phrases land on their first word (within 1 frame), others on the phrase's first stressed word, ~13 frames after its first word
animation.key_entry: same as its caption (no separate highlight animation, no word-by-word sweep)
animation.hook_title_entry: series label word slides up ~2 % H with blur, sharp in 2 frames from frame 0; the number pops in under it ~14 frames later (hard cut-in, no blur visible)
animation.topic_word_entry: drops in from above: starts ~1.5x size, blurred and partly off the top edge, scales down/slides into place over ~6 frames; lands exactly on its spoken word
animation.exit: hard cut (the previous caption disappears 0-1 frame before the next enters); the hook ends with a ~5-frame dip to black at ~7 % of runtime

other_text_spec.text: small two-tone logo wordmark (accent + dark), top-right, x 76-92 %, y 5-10 % (estimated)

other_text_spec.when: ~12-21 % and ~64-82 % of runtime (problem line and outcome line)
other_text_spec.text: rounded-corner illustration card x 3-97 %, y 5-35 %, radius ~3 % W (estimated), scale-in with blur over ~8 frames; face stays visible below
white flat illustrated scene (a few small animated props, e.g. a magnifier) with a dark bottom gradient; captions stay at ~80 % in white

other_text_spec.when: ~91-97 % of runtime (8-frame dip to black before, 10-frame fade to black after)
other_text_spec.text: black #0C0C0C geometric sans, centred: headline line at centre y 25.9 % (ink 3.59 % H, ~76 % W), a regular sub-line at ~29.5-31.5 %, a bold 'contact' line at ~36 %, logo at 44-62 %, a short follow prompt at centre y 72.8 % (ink 2.42 % H, ~46 % W), four black rounded-square social icons (like / comment / share / save) at ~78 %, website line at ~82.5 %

style.look_intent: high-contrast, muted, neutral-warm; natural clean skin, slightly cool busy work-set background

sound.music: music bed likely (heuristic, low level under continuous speech); calm corporate bed
sfx: whoosh on the zoom-blur punch-in and punch-out (inferred)
soft shimmer/whoosh on the light-leak flash before the CTA (inferred)
cuts sit on audio hits in a third of hard cuts (measured cut_hit_share 0.33)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: a single speaker pitches a service or solves one named business problem to camera
footage is one static angle and needs variety without cutting away from the face
the script has a clear pain noun per sentence and a short list of offerings
a numbered episode/series format ('problem #N') is planned
the brand wants a clean logo end card with follow prompt and website
avoid_when: fast high-energy edits or multi-speaker podcasts
light clothing / bright backgrounds behind the caption band (difference blend turns dark)
no images or illustrations are available for the PIP cards
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B38 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B38.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship — text and accent must stay >= 4.5:1 / >= 3:1 against what sits behind them on the footage):
- {{TEXT}}      default #FFFFFF (caption white, rendered with a difference blend)
- {{ACCENT}}    default #E06A2C (key word / topic word orange)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  default none (not used)
- {{SURFACE}}   default #FDFDFD (end-card background)
- {{CARD_BG}}   default none (end-card text / icons are near-black #0C0C0C on {{SURFACE}})
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} default Inter 800 (ExtraBold)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    default Inter 800 (ExtraBold)
- {{HANDLE}}    default @handle
- {{LOGO}}      default the brand's logo file (transparent PNG/SVG)
Accent must stay >= 3:1 on the footage behind the caption band; if the brand accent is dark, lift its lightness rather than changing the role.
Canvas 1080x1920, sizes below are px at that canvas; frame counts are at 25 fps (scale them if the project fps differs).

CAPTIONS
1. English as spoken, sentence case, keep commas / full stops at phrase ends. No emoji.
2. One phrase of 2-4 words per caption, ONE line, whole phrase at once. 0-1 key word per caption in {{ACCENT}}: the pain or outcome word; many captions have none.
3. Caption: {{FONT_BODY}} at 68 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, no stroke / shadow / box, centred, ink centre at 80 % of height, max line width ~72 % W. Key word: same font, 68-69 px, {{ACCENT}}.
4. Put the caption layer in mix-blend-mode: difference (stays {{TEXT}} over dark clothing, inverts where hands pass under). Drop the blend if the caption band sits on light clothing.
5. Entry: slide up from +4 % H with motion blur and scale 1.1 -> 1.0, ease-out; sharp after 6 frames, settled by 10 (centre 84.8 -> 82.3 -> 81.4 -> 81.0 -> 80.8 % at +2/+4/+6/+8/+10 f). Previous caption hard-cuts out 0-1 frame before. Land each phrase on its first stressed word (<= 3 frames late). No idle motion.
6. Repeated-lead list beats: two-line lockup, lead words 114 px at centre 74.8 % over the shared noun ~62 px at 79.4 %, held while each list item drops in as a topic word (rule 8).

OTHER TEXT (only where the script has a matching beat)
7. Hook title (first ~7 % of runtime): series label in {{TEXT}} {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 103 px centred at 78.9 % H, slides up 2 % H with blur over 2 frames on the first word; '#N' pops in on the next line (centre 84.4 %, ~1.6x size, leading ~0.85) ~14 frames later.
8. Topic word: UPPERCASE {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 118-130 px (set per word, keep inside ~72 % W), {{ACCENT}}, centred at 22-23 % H above the head; drops in from ~1.5x scale, blurred and partly off the top edge, settles in ~6 frames exactly on its spoken word.
9. {{LOGO}} watermark top-right (x 76-92 %, y 5-10 %) from ~10 % of runtime to the end.
10. PIP image cards on the problem and outcome lines (75-150 frames each): rounded corners (~3 % W radius), x 3-97 %, y 5-35 %, scale-in with blur over ~8 frames; the face stays visible below.
11. Optional full-screen flat illustration (~110 frames) with a dark bottom gradient; captions continue in {{TEXT}} at 80 %.
12. Transitions: one zoom-blur punch-in to ~115 % (~12 frames) mid-claim and back out; a 5-frame light-leak flash before the CTA. Skip the hook dip-to-black.
13. End card (~50 frames, after an 8-frame dip to black): flat {{SURFACE}}, centred near-black geometric sans — headline at 25.9 % (ink 3.6 % H, ~76 % W), sub-line ~30 %, 'contact' line ~36 %, {{LOGO}} 44-62 %, follow prompt at 72.8 % (ink 2.4 % H), four rounded-square social icons ~78 %, website line ~82.5 %; 10-frame fade to black.

GRADE
Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, muted, neutral-warm; natural clean skin.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render a test caption 'KEY WORD problems' with 'problems' in {{ACCENT}}, the hook word 'Challenge' and the topic word 'RETENTION', then measure:
   python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.05,0.76,0.95,0.84 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60,{{ACCENT}}:55"
   python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.08,0.15,0.92,0.29 --ink "{{ACCENT}}:60"
   Expected (±0.5 % H, ±2 % W) with Inter 800: 'problems' 3.36 % H / 28.3 % W at 69 px; 'Challenge' 5.08 % H / 45.6 % W at 103 px; 'RETENTION' 4.69 % H / 61.0 % W at 118 px. Measure white text over a dark area only.
b) For other words or a non-Inter brand font: python3 video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "<font weight>" --word "<word>" --ink <tier ink> [--upper] (caption 3.44 / key 3.36 / hook 5.08 / topic 4.69 --upper) -> use the returned px (Inter targets: caption 68, key 69, hook 103, topic 118-130, list lead 114 px) and expect at_verified_px.width_pct_of_W from the probe. (fit_font.py needs a target: --ink and/or --width; it returns the px that reproduces that ink for YOUR word plus the width it will read at that px. Requires Pillow.)
c) Positions within ±1 % H: caption ink centre 80 %, topic word 22-23 %, hook label 78.9 %, PIP card y 5-35 %.
